title: Room Booking & Sharing Documentation
projImgAlt: Room booking platform connecting guests with available rooms and homeowners
subtitle: Connect Guests With Available Rooms
desc: A room booking and sharing platform that connects guests looking for accommodation with homeowners who want to share their available rooms. Guests can discover and book available rooms, while homeowners can create and manage their own room listings. Administrators have full visibility across the platform and can manage users and monitor platform activities.

ProblemStat.title: Problem Statement
ProblemStat.text1: Guests often struggle to find available rooms that match their needs, while homeowners have limited ways to share their available rooms with potential guests.
ProblemStat.text2Special: This room booking platform solves that problem
ProblemStat.text2: by connecting guests with available rooms through a simple and convenient booking experience, while allowing homeowners to create and manage their own room listings.
